results.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle with all sheet coordinates in the semigroup ⟨37,52⟩.
results.proof_sketch: Fix orientations and minimize the sum of all left and top coordinates over the compact feasible configuration space. A sheet with positive left coordinate has a vertically overlapping sheet whose right edge touches its left edge; otherwise a translation below the finite minimum positive clearance decreases the objective. Following blockers strictly decreases x and ends at x=0, so every left and right coordinate is a nonnegative sum of 37 and 52. The same argument applies vertically. Exact semigroup enumeration gives maximum endpoints 1188 and 839; 1189, 840, and 841 are unrepresentable.

results.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
results.proof_sketch: Use (52i,37j;52,37) for 0≤i<20, 0≤j<3; (1040+37i,52j;37,52) for 0≤i<4, 0≤j<2; and (37i,111+52j;37,52) for 0≤i<32, 0≤j<14. These three grids are contained in 1188×839 and mutually interior-disjoint. They contain 60+8+448=516 sheets.

Mark unit cells with x+y≡50 (mod 52) and give them weight 1/37. Either tile orientation contains exactly 37 marked cells, so has weight one. The 1188×839 container has 19,162 marked cells, of total weight 19,162/37=517+33/37<518. This verified bound is retained, although the stronger obstruction below excludes 517 as well.

results.claim: A normalized 517-packing could have only one of four bounding dimensions: 1186×839, 1187×839, 1188×838, or 1188×839.
results.proof_sketch: The sheets have total area 517·52·37=994,708. If W and H are the maximum right and bottom endpoints, then W,H∈⟨37,52⟩, W≤1188, H≤839, and WH≥994,708. Since 1185·839 and 1188·837 are too small, W≥1186 and H≥838. Testing the six resulting pairs removes 1186×838 and 1187×838 by area, leaving exactly the four stated cases.

results.claim: The near-extremal side decompositions, and hence their normalization blocker chains, are rigid.
results.proof_sketch: Exact Diophantine enumeration gives 1186=10·52+18·37, 1187=15·52+11·37, 1188=20·52+4·37, 838=9·52+10·37, and 839=14·52+3·37, uniquely in nonnegative integers. A sheet attaining a maximum endpoint has a blocker chain whose widths or heights sum to that endpoint, so the corresponding chain has precisely the listed orientation counts.

results.claim: Every candidate 517-box has exact nonnegative line-defect identities summarized by four pairs of orientation equations.
results.proof_sketch: Let n count 52×37 sheets and m=517−n. Write H=37A+52C and W=52B+37D using the unique full-side decompositions. In column x, let a_x,b_x count the two orientations and g_x be uncovered cells. Then a_x=A+7g_x−52q_x and b_x=C−5g_x+37q_x for an integer q_x≥0. In row y, c_y=B−5k_y+37p_y and d_y=D+7k_y−52p_y with p_y≥0. Put Q=Σq_x, P=Σp_y and U=WH−517·52·37. Summing column and row incidences gives, respectively: for 1186×839, U=346 and n=115−Q=180+P; for 1187×839, U=1185 and n=228−Q=180+P; for 1188×838, U=836 and n=341−Q=340+P; for 1188×839, U=2024 and n=341−Q=180+P.

results.claim: Residue-class incidence gives exact lower bounds on the carry totals Q and P.
results.proof_sketch: Every 52-wide horizontal sheet meets one unit column in each class modulo 52. Thus, for a class containing ℓ columns, summing a_x gives n=Aℓ+7G−52Q_r, where G is its gap sum and Q_r its q-sum; modulo 7 fixes Q_r modulo 7, so nonnegativity gives a lower bound. Likewise, every 37-wide vertical sheet meets each column class modulo 37 once, giving m=Cℓ−5G+37Q_r and a modulo-5 lower bound. Finally, grouping rows modulo 52 for the 52-high vertical sheets gives m=Dℓ+7K−52P_s and a modulo-7 lower bound. Summing the least nonnegative residues bounds Q or P.
Its defect identities are n=115−Q and n=180+P. Since Q,P≥0, the first gives n≤115 and the second n≥180, an immediate contradiction.

Here n=341−Q=340+P, hence n is 340 or 341. There are 44 column classes modulo 52 containing 23 columns and 8 containing 22. With A=10, the least q-sums forced by n=Aℓ+7G−52Q_r are 3 and 2 when n=340, so Q≥44·3+8·2=148 although Q=1. For n=341 the least residues are 5 and 4, so Q≥44·5+8·4=252 although Q=0.

Now n=228−Q=180+P, so 180≤n≤228 and Q≤48. Modulo 52 there are 43 classes of 23 columns and 9 of 22. With A=3, every 23-column class has Q_r≡2(n−6) (mod 7). If t is the least nonnegative residue, then 43t≤Q≤48, so t is 0 or 1. Residue 0 forces n≡6 and then each 22-column class has Q_r≡6, already totaling 54; residue 1 forces n≡3, Q≥43, and hence n=185. Then m=332 and Q=43. But modulo 37 there are 34 classes of 32 columns, and m=14·32−5G+37Q_r forces Q_r≡2 (mod 5) in each. Thus Q≥68, contradiction.

results.claim: The full 1188×839 candidate box is impossible.
results.proof_sketch: The defect identities give Q=341−n and P=n−180, hence Q+P=161. Let r=n mod 7. Horizontal incidences in the 44 column classes of size 23 and 8 of size 22 give Q≥C_r. Vertical incidences in the 7 row classes of size 17 and 45 of size 16 give P≥R_r. Direct solution of the two one-variable congruences gives (C_r,R_r) for r=0,…,6 as (96,149), (200,45), (304,305), (44,201), (148,97), (252,42), (48,253). Their sums are 245,245,609,245,245,294,301, all greater than 161. This contradicts Q+P=161 for every possible n.

results.claim: The exact orthogonal packing number of A9 sheets in A0 is 516.
results.proof_sketch: The explicit grids give OPT≥516. If a packing had at least 517 sheets, select 517 and normalize them. Its bounding box would be one of the four candidates, each excluded above. Hence OPT≤516, and equality follows.

results.claim: The maximum size of a guillotine (slicing) A9-in-A0 packing is 516.
results.proof_sketch: Bottom-up compaction preserves a slicing tree and makes every node dimension a member of ⟨37,52⟩. The audited exact recurrence covers a leaf, monotone slack, every split into two representable widths, and every split into two representable heights. Structural induction proves completeness. Evaluation on all 396 representable widths through 1188 and 204 representable heights through 839 gives G(1188,839)=516, attained by the displayed slicing construction.

final_writeup:
The exact answer is

OPT(1189,841,52,37)=516.

Normalization and lower certificate. Fix sheet orientations and minimize the sum of all left and top coordinates over the compact feasible configuration space. Any sheet away from x=0 has a genuine left blocker; otherwise it can be shifted by less than the finite minimum positive clearance. Following blockers strictly decreases x and ends at zero, so every horizontal coordinate is a nonnegative sum of 37 and 52. The same holds vertically. Since 1189, 840, and 841 are not representable, every packing normalizes into 1188×839 with integer coordinates.

A packing of 516 is given by

(52i,37j;52,37), 0≤i<20, 0≤j<3;
(1040+37i,52j;37,52), 0≤i<4, 0≤j<2;
(37i,111+52j;37,52), 0≤i<32, 0≤j<14.

The three grids are mutually interior-disjoint and contain 60+8+448=516 sheets.

Bounding-box obstruction. Suppose there are 517 sheets; write n for the number oriented 52×37 and m=517−n for the number oriented 37×52. Their area is 994,708. If W,H are the maximum right and bottom endpoints after normalization, then W,H∈⟨37,52⟩, W≤1188, H≤839, and WH≥994,708. The only possibilities are

(1186,839), (1187,839), (1188,838), (1188,839).

The relevant unique decompositions are

1186=10·52+18·37, 1187=15·52+11·37, 1188=20·52+4·37,
838=9·52+10·37, 839=14·52+3·37.

Line-defect identities. Write H=37A+52C and W=52B+37D according to those decompositions. In unit column x let a_x,b_x be the numbers of horizontal and vertical sheets met, and let g_x=H−37a_x−52b_x. The Diophantine equation has the form

a_x=A+7g_x−52q_x,  b_x=C−5g_x+37q_x

for an integer q_x≥0. Indeed the first identity follows modulo 52, the second follows by substitution, and q_x<0 would force a_x>A+52>22. Analogously, in row y, with gap k_y,

c_y=B−5k_y+37p_y,  d_y=D+7k_y−52p_y

for p_y≥0. Put Q=Σq_x and P=Σp_y. Since each horizontal sheet contributes 52 column incidences and 37 row incidences, summing gives this exact table:

box          unused U     column identity   row identity
1186×839       346          n=115−Q           n=180+P
1187×839      1185          n=228−Q           n=180+P
1188×838       836          n=341−Q           n=340+P
1188×839      2024          n=341−Q           n=180+P.

Residue principle. A 52-wide sheet meets exactly one column in every residue class modulo 52. Hence, in a class containing ℓ columns, summing the first column identity gives

n=Aℓ+7G−52Q_r,

where G and Q_r are the class sums. Reduction modulo 7 fixes Q_r modulo 7, and Q_r is at least its least nonnegative residue. Similarly, grouping the vertical incidences by columns modulo 37 gives

m=Cℓ−5G+37Q_r,

which fixes Q_r modulo 5. Grouping vertical incidences by rows modulo 52 gives

m=Dℓ+7K−52P_s,

which fixes P_s modulo 7.

Eliminating the four boxes.

For 1186×839, the table simultaneously gives n≤115 and n≥180.

For 1188×838, n=341−Q=340+P, so n∈{340,341}. The 1188 columns form 44 residue classes of size 23 and 8 of size 22 modulo 52. With A=10, n=340 forces respective least q-sums 3 and 2, hence Q≥44·3+8·2=148 although Q=1. For n=341 they are 5 and 4, hence Q≥252 although Q=0.

For 1187×839, 180≤n≤228 and Q=228−n≤48. There are 43 modulo-52 column classes of size 23 and 9 of size 22. A size-23 class forces Q_r≡2(n−6) mod 7. The total bound makes this least residue 0 or 1. The first choice forces n≡6 and then the nine small classes contribute at least 9·6=54>Q. The second forces n≡3 and Q≥43, leaving only n=185. Thus m=332,Q=43. But modulo 37 there are 34 column classes of size 32, and each satisfies 332=14·32−5G+37Q_r, so Q_r≡2 mod 5. Therefore Q≥34·2=68, again impossible.

Finally take 1188×839. Here Q+P=(341−n)+(n−180)=161. For r=n mod 7, the modulo-52 column classes force Q≥C_r, and the modulo-52 row classes force P≥R_r. The seven exact pairs (C_r,R_r) are

(96,149), (200,45), (304,305), (44,201), (148,97), (252,42), (48,253).

Their sums are respectively 245,245,609,245,245,294,301, all exceeding 161. This excludes the last box.

Thus no 517-packing exists. Any larger packing would contain 517 sheets, so OPT≤516; the displayed placement proves equality.
